invariants.rationale: A new HashMap is always returned if small file limit <= 0; otherwise context.mapToPair or HashMap is assigned. Method never returns null.
If partitionPaths are not null or empty, the map is created over all partitionPaths, so returned map contains the keys.
At most, there can be one entry per partition path.
Each partition path gets one list of small files; no aggregation, so count matches.
Each value is constructed as a List<SmallFile> from getSmallFiles or new HashMap, never null.
